label: Fugue in D minor, BWV 565
note: from the Toccata and Fugue; perhaps not by Bach
caution: Read from Tobi's MusicXML file (Tobis Notenarchiv), notes, ties and names as they stand there; the voices were sorted by this program from the file's staves, stems and beams, and have not been proofread note by note. The pedal's line is the bass. This fugue is loosely made: much of it is a single line or two, with chords filled in; the fugue ends at bar 98, and what follows (the recitative and the chords of the close) is the toccata's manner again. The file gives each hand a staff of its own.
title: Toccata and Fugue in D minor, BWV 565: Fugue
procedures: a voice held back until after the exposition
